title: How to mass-apply for jobs using AI agents

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: AI can auto-generate and submit thousands of tailored applications in seconds using protocols like OAuth and REST APIs.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But how does that ensure quality? AI lacks human judgment, leading to generic, unconvincing applications that get filtered out by ATS.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: We use NLP models trained on real job descriptions to personalize each application—boosting relevance and pass rates by up to 40%.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Even with that, how do you avoid being flagged as spam? Mass submissions without IP diversity or behavioral patterns trigger bot detection.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: With rate-limiting and proxy rotation, we mimic human behavior—making scale and authenticity possible, not just theoretical.
